lead: Shehbaz Sharif is best known as a Pakistani politician, born on 23 September 1951 in Lahore.
As of 2026, he is 74 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has held the office of Chief Minister of Punjab and Chief Minister of Punjab.
This profile collects the Shehbaz facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Shehbaz Sharif — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shehbaz Sharif was born on 23 September 1951 in Lahore, and holds Pakistani nationality.
Public records name his father, Muhammad Sharif and his mother, Shamim Bibi. He is a sibling of Nawaz Sharif.
He received his education at St. Anthony's High School and Government College University.
He is recorded as speaking Punjabi.

sections.heading: Shehbaz Sharif — Career and Professional Work
paras: Shehbaz Sharif works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Punjab (2013–2018), Chief Minister of Punjab (1997–1999), Chief Minister of Punjab (2008–2013), President of the Pakistan Muslim League (N) (2009–2011), President of the Pakistan Muslim League (N) (2018–present) and Member of the 15th National Assembly of Pakistan. He is affiliated with Pakistan Muslim League (N).
He has taken part in FII 6th Edition in Riyadh.

sections.heading: Shehbaz Sharif — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Tehmina Durrani.
He is a parent to Muhammad Hamza Shahbaz Sharif, Rabia Imran and Suleman Shahbaz.

sections.heading: Shehbaz Sharif — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Shehbaz Sharif circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.
What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a politician, brand partnerships, sponsored social content and public office remuneration.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
